title: Aao akbar sehra
body:
aao akbar sehra baandho
<<DIVIDER>>
koi masnad laa ke bichao
koi aanchal sar pe chao
koi kaajal surma laao
koi mehndi rang rachao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera laal sada aabaad rahe
dil maa behno ka shaad rahe
sukhi jug jug ye aulaad rahe
mere mann ki poori muraad rahe
koi naade ali dohrao
poshaak shahani laao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi chaadar amma zehra ki
koi pagdi laao nana ki
chalo behno aao akbar ki
akbar ke lagao ab mehndi
phoolon ki sej sajao
ye baam o dar mehkao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
phooloan ko aabe kausar se
dhulwa ke buzar o qambar se
ye sehra lagana tab sar se
jab abr najaf se aa barse
abbas ka parcham lao
saaye mein is ko bithao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi sughra ko paigham ye do
akbar ki behan tum shaad raho
aane ki sakat ho to aao
aur naig tum apna le jaao
bhaiya ke gale lag jaao
ghoongat dulhan ka uthao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti hai sakina khush ho kar
doolha jo bane bhaiya akbar
main naig mein maangoongi gauhar
sar rakh ke un ke seene par
haq mera mujhe dilwao
mujhe bunde naye pehnao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
nagaah ye di haatif ne sada
ye zulm hua umme laila
seene mein laga us ke naiza
armaan tha jis ki shaadi ka
akbar ko kafan pehnao
zakhmon se khaak chudao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi hai kaleje mein tooti
haathon mein lagi khoon ki mehendi
sau tukde hui sehre ki ladi
sarwar pe qayamat ki hai ghadi
zainab ko hosh mein lao
lo farshe azaa ka bichao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
do qasid e sughra ko ye khabar
sughra ko bataye wo jaa kar
akbar to gaye suye kausar
kya takti hai sughra raah guzar
mat un se aas lagao
ab fateha un ki dilao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan tujhe akbar ki qasam
mat rok abhi tu apna qalam
wo baat tujhe karna hai raqam
gham ahle aza ka jis se ho kam
akbar ka sehra sunao
khud tadpo aur tadpao
aao akbar sehra...
author: Rehaan Azmi
